name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: Right-click (and touch long-press) menu that reuses the shared menu panel/items + menu.css owned by @hbd/dropdown. onContextMenu (mouse/pen) and a 500ms touch long-press (8px move tolerance) open a position:fixed panel at the cursor with viewport-edge flipping (clamp x/y on-screen). Reuses Dropdown.Item / Dropdown.Separator / Dropdown.Group as compound members, rebuilding them into role=menuitem rows with roving tabindex, Arrow/Home/End + first-character typeahead, Enter/Space activation, and the .is-focused state. Escape / click-outside / window-resize close; focus returns to the right-clicked host. hbd:select -> onSelect({ value, label }); onOpenChange notifies open/close. Owns NO CSS — the only shell rule (.hbd-context-menu { display: contents }) lives in the dropdown-owned menu.css.
